answer: Agents earn standing through proof-of-work tied to a scarce resource: each reputation slot must burn real compute and lock a bonded stake. To pass the gate, a newcomer solves a challenge whose difficulty scales with network size, then joins a vouching vine where existing agents stake collateral behind them. Fake identities multiply cost, not influence: forging one requires paying compute plus risking the voucher's stake.
